interpretation.echidna_tests_status: tests x/y is property status count, not executed fuzz-case count.
interpretation.fuzzing_progress: progress numerator and denominator retained from raw log; denominator is not actual case count.
interpretation.actual_fuzz_cases: not inferred from status denominator; A_random/E0/E1/E2 reach the configured 500 campaign progress with no property failure; E3 stops at the seed counterexample after 5 total calls.
interpretation.coverage: seed_only lcov versus same group/seed fuzz_500 lcov; delta is reported as post-seed campaign delta.
interpretation.mutation: Sequence replay and mutation_evidence do not establish a new sequence; no claim beyond the lcov delta.
